headline: The hole learned to spin
lede: BLACK HOLE got its Kerr upgrade: press K and the flyby hole starts dragging spacetime around with it — lopsided shadow, twisted starfield, and a disk that whips faster on the approaching side. Every asymmetry emerges from a real separated geodesic integrator; nothing is painted.

notes.text: Kerr null geodesics in the shader (Bardeen form, Carter constants, static-tetrad launch with the g-tphi cross term) — D-shaped shadow with prograde capture 0.157 vs retrograde 0.375, flipping with spin sign; the a=0 path stays bit-identical to the shipped Schwarzschild demo.
Lense-Thirring in numbers: co-rotating light bends 2.27 rad vs 1.35 counter-rotating, and GR reference radii (horizon, photon orbits, ISCOs) match the textbook at a*=0.9 through the JS mirror.
blackholecheck grew 75 to 87 gates, plus a sixth proven-fail mutant: delete the frame-shift term from the radial potential and the bend gate goes red while every Schwarzschild gate stays green.

Two physics bugs caught by impossible outputs: a missing covariant g-tphi term (R<0 at launch is impossible outside the horizon) and a zero-length final ray segment that faked pi/2 bends on every escape.
